name: RVQ quantize step latency (synthetic CPU)
spec_cadence: epoch=1s shift=0.25s → token-rate=4Hz → ≤ 20ms (4× headroom vs 250ms shift)
honest_caveats: Synthetic random codebooks — real RVQ codebooks (after k-means/EMA training) may have different cluster geometry → NN-search latency variance could shift.
CPU-only on M2 Pro (or local mac) — no Metal acceleration tested; production may use vectorized batch search.
4-mode batch heuristic (band-power + coherence + spike + raw quantized separately) — actual IMPL may share embedding space and quantize a single 384d vector per epoch, halving cost.
